5 Apr 2024
The insured reported a low-speed head-on collision at a residential intersection and said the other vehicle crossed
into their lane. The claimant was identified as the driver of the vehicle, and the police report confirms the claimant was
in the vehicle at the time.
1 Jul 2024
The driver is named on the policy, and the policy was in force at the time of the loss. Nothing suggests the damage
happened before the coverage started.
21 Jul 2024
Photos taken at the scene confirm some of the reported details, including the location of the impact and the rough
resting positions of both vehicles. No independent witnesses have come forward to describe how the collision
occurred.
23 Jul 2024
The claimant was contacted by phone and described the collision and the onset of back pain in the same way as in
the first conversation. The account has remained consistent across every contact so far.
13 Aug 2024
The claimant reports a back strain and has been seen at a clinic for treatment. The treatment has run somewhat
longer than is typical for this kind of injury, so the file will be monitored.
21 Aug 2024
No earlier injury to the same body area is known from the claimant's history or from prior claims. It is not yet clear
whether the back injury was caused by this collision or by something else.
22 Aug 2024
The vehicle was inspected at a repair facility. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known from our records or from the
inspection.
28 Aug 2024
The inspection found damage to the front bumper, hood, and radiator support. It is not yet clear whether all of the
damage came from this impact, so the repair estimate is being reviewed line by line.
17 Oct 2024
The repair estimate has been sent to the body shop for a second look at the areas that may have been damaged in
an earlier event. The shop has been asked to note which parts were visibly damaged in the photos.
5 Nov 2024
The claim file has been reviewed against the photos, the police report, and the statements taken so far. The core
facts of the collision are supported, but the extent of the injury and vehicle damage sitll needs work.
9 Nov 2024
A rqeuest for the claimant's medical records has been sent with their consent. Once the records arrive, the causation
question on the back injury will be revisited with the treating provider.
23 Nov 2024
The file remains open pending receipt of the medical records and the final repair figures. The next review is

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
